text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Organized into clear sections ('To begin with my talent', 'Next my skill', 'Finally both of my skill and talent', 'In conclusion')","quality":"Structural organization","description":"The degree to which an essay follows a logical sequence with distinct paragraphs and structural markers."},{"evidence":"Clear explanation of how physical movements are used to execute skills, such as balling up fists while running","quality":"Expository detail","description":"The inclusion of concrete, descriptive details that elaborate clearly on the essay's core ideas."},{"evidence":"Directly addresses the prompt by distinguishing between talents and skills and providing specific personal examples","quality":"Task responsiveness","description":"How fully and directly the essay fulfills all aspects of the writing prompt."},{"evidence":"Fewer run-on sentences and clearer sentence boundaries compared to Essay A's rambling statements","quality":"Sentence boundary control","description":"The ability to construct distinct sentences without relying on run-ons or comma splices."}]}
